title: Casper and the Ember
author: Rafael Thackeray
blurb: Odile Eriksen, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
